title: Pure Rose Dragon
summary: Rose Dragon and Rose cards built around Black Rose Dragon, with generic staples; the page's Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon is left out. The 2025 wave leads. Black Rose Garden searches a Rose Dragon from the Deck or GY and turns every monster on the field into a Plant, and when Black Rose Dragon's summon wipes the field it destroys the Garden for 2400 damage. Twilight Rose Black Knight is the Plant Tuner that Bramble Rose Dragon needs and revives Black Rose Dragon. Bramble Rose Dragon taxes every monster effect the opponent activates and tributes itself on either turn to Synchro Summon Black Rose Dragon. Rage Rose Witch keeps your Plants from being destroyed by effects. Roxrose Dragon, which searches any card that mentions Black Rose Dragon, is the Normal Summon. Crossrose Dragon is left out because it needs two monsters with different Types, which Black Rose Garden makes impossible.
main: Roxrose Dragon
Starter: searches any card that mentions Black Rose Dragon, including Black Rose Garden.
Twilight Rose Black Knight
Newest Plant Tuner: revives Black Rose Dragon or a small Plant; shifts a Plant's Level by 1.
White Rose Dragon
Normal Summoned: summons a Rose Dragon from the hand or GY; summons itself next to a Dragon or Plant Tuner.
Red Rose Dragon
Tuner: as Synchro Material, summons a Rose Dragon from the Deck and searches Frozen Rose or Blooming.
Blue Rose Dragon
Revives Black Rose Dragon or a Plant when it is destroyed.
Rose Girl
Plant Tuner: summons itself when a Plant goes to the GY; returns to the hand.
Rose Shaman
Tributes itself to draw; recovers a Plant from the GY.
Black Rose Garden
Newest Spell: searches a Rose Dragon, turns every monster into a Plant, burns when Black Rose Dragon destroys it.
Frozen Rose
Quick-Play: sends a monster for a Plant search or a draw.
Basal Rose Shoot
Quick-Play: summons a Rose Dragon from the hand or GY; revives Black Rose Dragon when destroyed.
White Rose Cloister
Field Spell: summons a Rose Dragon or Plant from the hand on an empty field.
Blooming of the Darkest Rose
Rose Tokens for Synchros; protects Black Rose Dragon from the GY.
extra: Level 7: destroys every card on the field when Synchro Summoned.
Newest Synchro: burns and shrinks on each monster effect; becomes Black Rose Dragon on either turn.
Level 6: your Plants can't be destroyed by card effects; mills Plants from the Deck and Extra Deck.
Level 10: banishes both GYs and wipes the field; negates destruction.
Level 7: bounces a Special Summoned monster.
Level 5: revives a Rose Dragon or Dragon Synchro from the GY.
Level 5 Synchro Tuner: Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn.
